Terms of Service

By downloading, installing, or using the KodaHosting mobile application, the Web Dashboard, and related services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these Terms, you must uninstall the app and cease using our services immediately.

Eligibility & Age Requirements

You must be at least 16 years old to use this Service (the age of digital consent under Article 8 GDPR as implemented in Germany). Users under 16 require the consent of their legal guardian to use the Service. By agreeing to these Terms, you represent and warrant that you meet these age requirements, or that you have obtained the necessary consent from your legal guardian.

1. Service Overview

KodaHosting provides a mobile environment and networking infrastructure that allows you to host Minecraft servers directly from your Android device. We provide the networking tunnels to proxy incoming player connections securely to your device. Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Users are required to comply with the official Minecraft EULA when operating servers.

KodaHosting is provided completely free of charge. There are no purchases, no subscriptions, and no premium features. The full functionality of the app is available to all users at no cost.

Server Limit: Each account may host a maximum of six (6) servers simultaneously. This limit applies across all server types (Minecraft and databases combined) and is enforced to ensure fair use of the shared VPS proxy infrastructure.

Voluntary Support via Ko-fi: The app includes an optional link to Ko-fi, a third-party platform where users may choose to make a voluntary financial contribution to support ongoing development. Donations are entirely optional and do not unlock any features, content, or special treatment within the app. Ko-fi is a separate service with its own terms and policies; any donation you make through Ko-fi is governed by Ko-fi's terms and is non-refundable except as provided by Ko-fi's own policies. Donations do not create any contractual obligation on the part of the developer.

1a. Third-Party Mods, Plugins and Modpacks

KodaHosting can search and download content from Modrinth and CurseForge. All mods, plugins and modpacks are third-party content and remain the property of their authors. Your use of that content is governed by the provider's terms and the content's license. We do not host, review, endorse or guarantee third-party content. Some CurseForge authors disable third-party downloads; the app respects that and only offers a link to CurseForge. Do not redistribute downloaded content unless its license allows it.

2. Acceptable Use Policy

You agree to use KodaHosting solely for its intended purpose: hosting personal game servers. You are entirely responsible for the content, worlds, and plugins loaded onto your servers.

Strict Prohibitions

The following actions are strictly prohibited and will result in an immediate, permanent ban from KodaHosting services without warning:

  • Reverse Engineering: You may not decompile, reverse engineer, decrypt, or otherwise attempt to extract the source code of proprietary components of the KodaHosting App, our official plugins, or our networking binaries. This prohibition does not restrict the rights granted to you by the free and open-source licenses that apply to open-source components distributed with or used by the app (including the GNU General Public License); for those components, the terms of their respective licenses apply.
  • Unauthorized Tunnels: You may not use the KodaHosting network infrastructure to host unauthorized tunnels, VPNs, proxies, or any traffic that is not standard Minecraft gameplay data.
  • Malicious Activity & Password Stealing: You may not use our services to host malware, execute phishing campaigns, or attempt to steal passwords, session tokens, or personal data from joining players or other users.
  • Circumventing the Server Limit: You may not create multiple accounts, share accounts, or use any other method to circumvent the maximum six-server limit per user.

3. User Responsibilities & Indemnification

You are solely responsible for all activity that occurs under your account and for all content hosted on your servers. You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the developer, their legal guardians, and any affiliated parties from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or relating to:

  • Your use of or inability to use the Service;
  • Your violation of these Terms or the Acceptable Use Policy;
  • Your violation of any third-party rights, including the Minecraft EULA, copyright, or privacy rights;
  • Any content, worlds, plugins, or configurations you upload or host on your servers;
  • Any damage to your own device, other users' devices, or third-party systems caused by your use of the Service.

This indemnification obligation survives the termination of your account or these Terms.

4. Service Reliability & Uptime

Because the servers run on your own hardware, uptime depends directly on your device's power state and network connectivity. KodaHosting does not guarantee 100% uptime for our central proxy routing infrastructure, though we strive for maximum reliability. The Service is provided on a best-effort basis without any uptime commitment. We reserve the right to temporarily restrict or suspend access during maintenance, infrastructure changes, or in case of suspected abuse.

5. Account Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account and access to the KodaHosting proxy infrastructure at any time, for any reason, particularly if you violate the Acceptable Use Policy. Upon termination, all data stored on your device remains yours; we do not retain server data after account deletion. We may also delete accounts that have been inactive for an extended period.

6. Disclaimer of Warranties

THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" BASIS. WE EXPRESSLY DISCLAIM ALL WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free, nor do we guarantee the safety of your device data.

The Service is a hobby project provided by a single developer. It is not a commercial product and does not meet the standards of professional, enterprise-grade hosting services. You use the Service at your own risk.

1. Leistungsbeschreibung

KodaHosting stellt eine mobile Umgebung und Netzwerkinfrastruktur bereit, mit der du Minecraft-Server direkt auf deinem Android-Gerät hosten kannst. Wir stellen die Netzwerktunnel bereit, um eingehende Spielerverbindungen sicher an dein Gerät weiterzuleiten. Kein offizielles Minecraft-Produkt. Nicht von Mojang oder Microsoft genehmigt oder mit ihnen verbunden. Nutzer müssen beim Betrieb von Servern die offizielle Minecraft-EULA einhalten.

KodaHosting ist vollständig kostenlos. Es gibt keine Käufe, keine Abonnements und keine Premium-Funktionen. Der volle Funktionsumfang der App steht allen Nutzern kostenlos zur Verfügung.

Server-Limit: Jedes Konto darf maximal sechs (6) Server gleichzeitig betreiben. Dieses Limit gilt übergreifend für alle Servertypen (Minecraft und Datenbanken zusammen) und wird durchgesetzt, um die faire Nutzung der gemeinsamen VPS-Proxy-Infrastruktur zu gewährleisten.

Freiwillige Unterstützung über Ko-fi: Die App enthält einen optionalen Link zu Ko-fi, einer Drittanbieter-Plattform, auf der Nutzer optional eine freiwillige finanzielle Unterstützung zur Förderung der Entwicklung leisten können.   • Bösartige Aktivitäten und Passwortdiebstahl: Du darfst unsere Dienste nicht nutzen, um Schadsoftware zu hosten, Phishing-Kampagnen durchzuführen oder zu versuchen, Passwörter, Session-Tokens oder personenbezogene Daten von beigetretenen Spielern oder anderen Nutzern zu stehlen.
  • Umgehung des Server-Limits: Du darfst keine mehreren Konten erstellen, Konten teilen oder andere Methoden verwenden, um das Maximum von sechs Servern pro Nutzer zu umgehen.

3. Nutzerpflichten und Freistellung

Last Updated: November 2026

Privacy Policy

1. Introduction & Data Controller

Welcome to KodaHosting. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any information that may be processed while you use our mobile application and the accompanying Web Dashboard. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.

The Data Controller responsible for your personal information is:

Karol Brzostowski

Deutschland Fixberg 17, 33106 Paderborn-Wewer

Email: support@kodaserv.eu

Note on Legal Capacity: The developer of KodaHosting is a minor under German law (§ 106 BGB, beschränkte Geschäftsfähigkeit). Legal responsibility for the operation of this service, including data protection matters, is jointly held by the legal guardians. Correspondence regarding data protection, including requests under the GDPR, can be addressed to the email above. The legal guardians can be reached via the same address.

2. Information We Collect & Process

KodaHosting processes certain data to function correctly:

  • Account Information: When you register or log in, we securely process your email address and authentication details to manage your personal KodaHosting account. Authentication is handled securely by our partner, Supabase. We do not process your password directly. Supabase handles password storage and verification using industry-standard hashing algorithms.
  • Web Dashboard & Remote Control: When using the Web Dashboard, we process your authentication tokens and proxy server commands securely via our API to allow remote management of your Android-hosted servers. This includes server start, stop, restart, hibernate, wipe, and delete commands, as well as property changes (RAM, MOTD, gamemode, difficulty, max players, PvP, whitelist) and console commands.
  • Local Data: Your Minecraft server files, worlds, plugins, and configurations are stored purely locally on your device. We never access, transmit, or store this data on our servers. The developer cannot access, view, or recover your server files under any circumstances.
  • Biometric Data: If you enable Biometric Security in the app settings, your device's fingerprint or face scan is used. This data never leaves your device and is processed securely by Android's local biometric system. We have no access to biometric data and cannot store or transmit it.
  • Device Information: We check your device architecture (e.g., ARM64) and Android version locally to download the correct Java runtime environments and binary files. This information is not transmitted to us.
  • IP Privacy: Your personal home IP address is never leaked. All multiplayer traffic is routed through our central VPS infrastructure. Players connecting to your server will only ever see the IP address of our secure proxy. We do not log player IP addresses beyond what is technically necessary for the operation of the proxy tunnel.
  • AI Server Builder: If you use the AI Server Builder, your text prompts are sent to the Google Gemini API for processing to generate server configurations. Do not submit sensitive personal information in these prompts. Data transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA) to Google LLC is safeguarded under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and Standard Contractual Clauses. We do not store your prompts or the generated configurations on our servers.
  • AI Crash Analysis ("Ask AI", opt-in): If you explicitly consent and tap "Ask AI" after a crash, the last portion of your app log (up to approximately 1,000 lines), basic device information (model, RAM, Android version), and the affected server's configuration are transmitted to OpenRouter, a U.S.-based AI gateway, for analysis. OpenRouter routes the request through third-party AI models, which may include models by NVIDIA (Nemotron), MiniMax, Dots Studio, inclusionAI (Ling), and Google (Gemma). The feature is limited to 10 requests per day, requires explicit consent before every first use, and can be revoked at any time in the app settings. Do not use this feature if your logs may contain sensitive personal information. Transfers to the U.S. are safeguarded under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable to the respective model provider.
  • Support Tickets: If you contact us through the in-app support ticket system, the developer console, or request a password reset or verification code, we process your email address and your message, including diagnostic information attached to the ticket (device model, app version, memory, network type, and the names and status of your hosted servers). Emails are delivered via Resend, a third-party email delivery service.
  • Developer Console: If you publish extensions, you sign in to the web developer console with your KodaHosting account. We process your email address, verification status, extension metadata and packages, release versions, store listings, review notes, and developer support tickets. The console is hosted on the same infrastructure and uses the same account.
  • Extension Download Statistics (first-party): When an extension is downloaded from the in-app store, we store the extension id, version, time, the device model, Android version and app build sent by the app, and whether the download came from the app or the website. This record contains no account id, device id, advertising id or IP address and is not linked to your account. Developers see only aggregated counts for their own extensions (for example which device models or app builds download them).
  • Voluntary Donations: If you choose to support development via Ko-fi, you will be redirected to ko-fi.com, which processes the donation independently. Ko-fi may collect your name, email, and payment information. We do not process or store your payment data. Ko-fi's privacy policy applies to donations. Donations are voluntary gifts and do not create a customer relationship with us.

3. Legal Basis for Processing (Art. 6 GDPR)

We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

  • Article 6(1)(b) GDPR: For the performance of a contract (account creation, server hosting).
  • Article 6(1)(f) GDPR: Legitimate interests in operating and securing the Service, preventing abuse, maintaining infrastructure, and producing aggregated, non-account-linked extension download statistics for developers.
  • Article 6(1)(a) GDPR: Your consent, where applicable (e.g., biometric authentication, AI Server Builder prompts).

You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

4. Third-Party Services

The App utilizes certain third-party services that may collect information used to identify you or provide core functionalities:

  • Google Play Services: For app distribution and in-app updates. Crash and diagnostic data may be processed by Google via Google Play's standard developer diagnostics (Android Vitals). We do not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs; the extension download statistics described above are generated by our own API.
  • Supabase: For authentication and real-time database functionality (server management state). Supabase stores your email address and authentication token in encrypted form.
  • OpenRouter: For the optional, consent-based AI crash analysis described in Section 2. OpenRouter is the processor that forwards requests to third-party AI model providers (see Section 2 for the list of possible providers).
  • Resend: For delivering transactional emails (verification codes, password resets, support correspondence) to your email address.
  • Modrinth and CurseForge APIs: To search for and download plugins, mods and modpacks. The search term, the selected Minecraft version and server type, and your IP address are sent to the selected provider. CurseForge requests use an app-level API key; no account data or device identifier is sent. Modrinth privacy: https://modrinth.com/legal/privacy. CurseForge/Overwolf privacy: https://legal.overwolf.com/docs/overwolf/platform/platform-privacy-policy/.
  • PaperMC and SpigotMC: To download server software and version metadata.
  • GitHub Releases: Used to download essential server binaries like Java and secure tunnel clients.
  • Bore / FRP (Fast Reverse Proxy): Used exclusively to create the secure network tunnels between your device and our VPS infrastructure.
  • Ko-fi: Used for voluntary financial support of the developer. Ko-fi is an external service; visiting their site or making a donation is subject to their terms and privacy policy. Donations are voluntary gifts and do not unlock any features.

Where a provider processes data on our behalf (for example Supabase for storage and authentication, or the AI providers for crash analysis), it acts as our processor under Art. 28 GDPR and is bound by a data processing agreement. Where a provider decides on its own about the processing (for example when a payment or donation page is opened), it is a separate controller for that part and its own privacy policy applies. We recommend reviewing their respective privacy policies.

5. Data Security

We value your trust in using our App. Since the core functionality is local server hosting, your personal server data remains entirely on your device. Any data transmitted to APIs (like plugin search queries) is sent over secure, encrypted connections (HTTPS).

However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. The Service is a hobby project maintained by a single developer and does not provide the security guarantees of a commercial enterprise-grade service.

6. Data Retention

We retain your account information (email address and authentication data) for as long as your account is active. Server management metadata (server names, configurations, status) is stored in the Supabase database and is deleted when you delete the corresponding server or your account.

Upon account deletion, all associated data is permanently removed from our systems within 30 days, with the exception of data that we are legally required to retain or that is stored in backup systems (which will be deleted according to the backup retention cycle).

The following retention rules apply in addition:

  • Extension download statistics are stored for 12 months and then deleted automatically by a daily cleanup job. They are not linked to an account.
  • If you request a full data deletion and it is approved, your account and all personal data that is not legally required are deleted immediately. Records we must retain are moved into a separate, access-restricted retention table and deleted when the legal deadline ends: billing and payment records after 10 years (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB), contract and server records after 6 years, and security or abuse evidence after 180 days.
  • Data export requests create a ZIP in our storage. The download link is valid for seven days; after that you can request a new export. The export contains the data stored for your account and linked devices, including extension publishing data if you used the developer console.
  • Support tickets, including developer support tickets, are kept while the ticket is open and for as long as needed to handle follow-up questions, then deleted with the account or earlier on request.
  • Published extension packages are retained for 365 days. Only the newest approved package is publicly downloadable; support may hand out an older release inside this window for a documented reason, for example a legal request. After 365 days older package files are deleted, while the newest approved package stays available.

7. Your GDPR Rights (User Rights)

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable privacy laws, you have the following rights:

  • Right to Access (Art. 15 GDPR): You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Right to Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You may update or correct your account information.
  • Right to Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You can request the permanent deletion of your account and associated email address at any time.
  • Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You may request that we restrict the processing of your personal data under certain conditions.
  • Right to Data Portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You can request a machine-readable copy of your personal data.
  • Right to Object (Art. 21 GDPR): You may object to the processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent (Art. 7(3) GDPR): You may withdraw any consent you have given at any time.

To exercise these rights, please contact us at support@kodaserv.eu. If you are under 16, your request must be submitted by or with the consent of your legal guardian.

You can also use the account screen in the app: "Request my data" creates a data export after an admin review, "Request full data deletion" starts a deletion request that must be approved by an admin, and "My requests" shows the status. The developer console offers the same account and support paths for extension developers.

8. Children's Privacy

The App is intended for general use. Under Article 8 of the GDPR as implemented in Germany, users under the age of 16 require the consent of their legal guardian to create an account and use services that process personal data.

If you are under 16, please ask your legal guardian to review this Privacy Policy and to consent to your use of KodaHosting on your behalf before you create an account.

If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child under 16 without verifiable parental consent, we will take steps to delete such information as soon as possible.

9. International Data Transfers

Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), in particular:

  • United States: For services like Supabase, OpenRouter (AI crash analysis), Google, GitHub, and Ko-fi.
  • Other countries: As required by the third-party services listed in Section 4.

Such transfers are made only to recipients that provide an adequate level of protection as required by the GDPR, through Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF), or other lawful transfer mechanisms.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and, where appropriate, via the app. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

11. Right to Lodge a Complaint

You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement, if you believe that the processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR.

The competent supervisory authority for Germany is:

Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen

Kavalleriestraße 2-4, 40213 Düsseldorf

https://www.ldi.nrw.de

12. Contact Us

If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, or if you wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us at:

Email: support@kodaserv.eu

For matters concerning the developer's status as a minor, the legal guardians can be reached via the same email address.

KodaHosting verarbeitet bestimmte Daten, um korrekt zu funktionieren:

  • Web-Dashboard und Fernsteuerung: Bei Nutzung des Web-Dashboards verarbeiten wir deine Authentifizierungs-Tokens und Proxy-Server-Befehle sicher über unsere API, um die Fernverwaltung deiner auf Android gehosteten Server zu ermöglichen. Dies umfasst Start, Stopp, Neustart, Hibernate, Wipe und Löschung von Servern sowie Eigenschaftsänderungen (RAM, MOTD, Spielmodus, Schwierigkeit, maximale Spieler, PvP, Whitelist) und Konsolenbefehle.
  • Lokale Daten: Deine Minecraft-Serverdateien, Welten, Plugins und Konfigurationen werden ausschließlich lokal auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Wir greifen niemals auf diese Daten zu, übertragen sie nicht auf unsere Server und speichern sie dort nicht. Der Entwickler kann unter keinen Umständen auf deine Serverdateien zugreifen, sie einsehen oder wiederherstellen.
  • Biometrische Daten: Wenn du die biometrische Sicherheit in den App-Einstellungen aktivierst, wird der Fingerabdruck- oder Gesichtsscan deines Geräts verwendet. Diese Daten verlassen dein Gerät niemals und werden sicher vom lokalen Biometrie-System von Android verarbeitet. Wir haben keinen Zugriff auf biometrische Daten und können sie weder speichern noch übertragen.
  • Geräteinformationen: Wir prüfen deine Gerätearchitektur (z.B. ARM64) und Android-Version lokal, um die richtigen Java-Laufzeitumgebungen und Binärdateien herunterzuladen. Diese Informationen werden nicht an uns übertragen.
  • IP-Privatsphäre: Deine private IP-Adresse zu Hause wird niemals offengelegt. Der gesamte Multiplayer-Verkehr läuft über unsere zentrale VPS-Infrastruktur. Spieler, die sich mit deinem Server verbinden, sehen ausschließlich die IP-Adresse unseres sicheren Proxys. Wir protokollieren Spieler-IP-Adressen nicht über das technisch Notwendige für den Betrieb des Proxy-Tunnels hinaus.
  • KI-Server-Builder: Wenn du den KI-Server-Builder verwendest, werden deine Text-Eingaben zur Erzeugung von Serverkonfigurationen an die Google-Gemini-API gesendet. Übermittele in diesen Eingaben keine sensiblen personenbezogenen Daten. Übermittlungen außerhalb des Europäischen Wirtschaftsraums (EWR) an Google LLC sind über das EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) und Standardvertragsklauseln abgesichert. Wir speichern deine Eingaben oder die erzeugten Konfigurationen nicht auf unseren Servern.
  • KI-Crash-Analyse („KI fragen", Opt-in): Wenn du ausdrücklich zustimmst und nach einem Absturz auf „KI fragen" tippst, werden der letzte Teil deiner App-Logdatei (bis zu etwa 1.000 Zeilen), grundlegende Geräteinformationen (Modell, RAM, Android-Version) sowie die Konfiguration des betroffenen Servers zur Analyse an OpenRouter übermittelt, ein in den USA ansässiger KI-Gateway. OpenRouter leitet die Anfrage über Drittanbieter-KI-Modelle weiter, wozu Modelle von NVIDIA (Nemotron), MiniMax, Dots Studio, inclusionAI (Ling) und Google (Gemma) gehören können. Die Funktion ist auf 10 Anfragen pro Tag begrenzt, setzt vor der ersten Nutzung eine ausdrückliche Einwilligung voraus und kann jederzeit in den App-Einstellungen widerrufen werden. Nutze diese Funktion nicht, wenn deine Logs sensible personenbezogene Daten enthalten können. Übermittlungen in die USA sind über das EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) und Standardvertragsklauseln abgesichert, soweit diese für den jeweiligen Modellanbieter gelten.
  • Support-Tickets: Wenn du uns über das In-App-Support-Ticket-System, die Entwicklerkonsole oder einen Passwort-Reset bzw. einen Verifizierungscode kontaktierst, verarbeiten wir deine E-Mail-Adresse und deine Nachricht einschließlich der dem Ticket beigefügten Diagnoseinformationen (Gerätemodell, App-Version, Arbeitsspeicher, Netzwerktyp sowie Namen und Status deiner gehosteten Server). E-Mails werden über Resend, einen E-Mail-Zustelldienst von Drittanbietern, zugestellt.
  • Entwicklerkonsole: Wenn du Erweiterungen veröffentlichst, meldest du dich mit deinem KodaHosting-Konto in der Web-Entwicklerkonsole an. Ko-fi erfasst möglicherweise deinen Namen, deine E-Mail-Adresse und Zahlungsinformationen. Wir verarbeiten oder speichern deine Zahlungsdaten nicht. Für Spenden gilt die Datenschutzerklärung von Ko-fi. Spenden sind freiwillige Geschenke und begründen kein Kundenverhältnis mit uns.

3. Rechtsgrundlagen der Verarbeitung (Art. 6 DSGVO)

  • Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f DSGVO: Berechtigte Interessen am Betrieb und der Sicherung des Dienstes, der Missbrauchsverhinderung, der Aufrechterhaltung der Infrastruktur sowie an aggregierten, nicht kontobezogenen Erweiterungs-Downloadstatistiken für Entwickler.
  • Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a DSGVO: Deine Einwilligung, soweit einschlägig (z.B. biometrische Authentifizierung, Eingaben im KI-Server-Builder, KI-Crash-Analyse).

Du kannst eine Einwilligung jederzeit widerrufen, ohne dass die Rechtmäßigkeit der bis zum Widerruf erfolgten Verarbeitung berührt wird.

Die App nutzt bestimmte Drittanbieter-Dienste, die Informationen erfassen können, die zur Identifizierung genutzt werden oder Kernfunktionen bereitstellen:

Wir wissen dein Vertrauen bei der Nutzung unserer App zu schätzen. Da die Kernfunktion lokale Server-Hosts sind, bleiben deine persönlichen Serverdaten vollständig auf deinem Gerät. Wir speichern deine Kontoinformationen (E-Mail-Adresse und Authentifizierungsdaten), solange dein Konto aktiv ist. Serververwaltungs-Metadaten (Servernamen, Konfigurationen, Status) werden in der Supabase-Datenbank gespeichert und gelöscht, wenn du den entsprechenden Server oder dein Konto löschst.

Nach der Kontolöschung werden alle zugehörigen Daten innerhalb von 30 Tagen dauerhaft aus unseren Systemen entfernt, mit Ausnahme von Daten, die wir gesetzlich aufbewahren müssen oder die in Backup-Systemen gespeichert sind (die gemäß dem Backup-Zyklus gelöscht werden).

Nach der Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO) und anwendbaren Datenschutzgesetzen hast du folgende Rechte:

  • Recht auf Löschung (Art. 17 DSGVO): Du kannst jederzeit die dauerhafte Löschung deines Kontos und deiner E-Mail-Adresse anfordern.
  • Recht auf Einschränkung der Verarbeitung (Art. 18 DSGVO): Du kannst unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen die Einschränkung der Verarbeitung verlangen.
  • Recht auf Datenübertragbarkeit (Art. 20 DSGVO): Du kannst eine maschinenlesbare Kopie deiner personenbezogenen Daten anfordern.
  • Widerspruchsrecht (Art. 21 DSGVO): Du kannst der Verarbeitung deiner Daten auf Grundlage berechtigter Interessen widersprechen.
  • Recht auf Widerruf der Einwilligung (Art. 7 Abs. 3 DSGVO): Du kannst jederzeit eine erteilte Einwilligung widerrufen.

Die Entwicklerkonsole bietet dieselben Konto- und Support-Wege für Erweiterungs-Entwickler.

8. Datenschutz von Kindern

Die App ist für die allgemeine Nutzung bestimmt. Nach Art. 8 DSGVO in der deutschen Umsetzung benötigen Nutzer unter 16 Jahren die Einwilligung ihres gesetzlichen Vertreters, um ein Konto zu erstellen und Dienste zu nutzen, die personenbezogene Daten verarbeiten.

Wenn du unter 16 bist, bitte deinen gesetzlichen Vertreter, diese Datenschutzerklärung zu prüfen und deiner Nutzung von KodaHosting zuzustimmen, bevor du ein Konto erstellst.

Sollten wir Kenntnis davon erlangen, dass wir personenbezogene Daten eines Kindes unter 16 ohne überprüfbare elterliche Zustimmung erhoben haben, werden wir Schritte unternehmen, diese Informationen so schnell wie möglich zu löschen.

9. Internationale Datenübermittlungen

Deine personenbezogenen Daten können in Länder außerhalb des Europäischen Wirtschaftsraums (EWR) übermittelt und dort verarbeitet werden, insbesondere:

  • USA: Für Dienste wie Supabase, OpenRouter (KI-Crash-Analyse), Google, GitHub und Ko-fi.
  • Andere Länder: Wie für die in Abschnitt 4 genannten Drittanbieter erforderlich.

Solche Übermittlungen erfolgen nur an Empfänger, die ein angemessenes Schutzniveau gemäß DSGVO bieten, und zwar über Standardvertragsklauseln (SCCs), das EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) oder andere rechtmäßige Übermittlungsmechanismen.

10. Änderungen dieser Datenschutzerklärung

Wir können diese Datenschutzerklärung von Zeit zu Zeit aktualisieren. Über wesentliche Änderungen informieren wir, indem wir die neue Datenschutzerklärung auf dieser Seite veröffentlichen und, wo angemessen, über die App. Es wird empfohlen, diese Erklärung regelmäßig auf Änderungen zu prüfen. Die fortgesetzte Nutzung des Dienstes nach Änderungen gilt als Annahme der aktualisierten Erklärung.

11. Beschwerderecht

Du hast das Recht, dich bei einer Aufsichtsbehörde zu beschweren, insbesondere in dem EU-Mitgliedstaat deines gewöhnlichen Aufenthalts, deiner Arbeitsstelle oder des Ortes des mutmaßlichen Verstoßes, wenn du der Ansicht bist, dass die Verarbeitung deiner personenbezogenen Daten gegen die DSGVO verstößt.

Die zuständige Aufsichtsbehörde für Deutschland ist:

Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen

Kavalleriestraße 2-4, 40213 Düsseldorf

https://www.ldi.nrw.de

12. Kontakt

Wenn du Fragen oder Anregungen zu unserer Datenschutzerklärung hast oder deine Datenschutzrechte ausüben möchtest, kontaktiere uns unter:

E-Mail: support@kodaserv.eu

In Angelegenheiten, die den Status des Entwicklers als Minderjährigen betreffen, sind die gesetzlichen Vertreter über dieselbe E-Mail-Adresse erreichbar.
